blocks.html: In the districts indicated, for zoning lots containing community facility and residential uses, the maximum floor area ratio permitted for a community facility use shall be as set forth in Section 24-11, inclusive, and the maximum floor area ratio permitted for a residential use shall be as set forth in Article II, Chapter 3, provided the total of all such floor area ratios does not exceed the greatest floor area ratio permitted for any such use on the zoning lot.
